title: Introduce credential-waterfall middleware and stream-prefetch helpers (TS SDK v1.7.0)
author: Asha Kapoor
release_notes: TS SDK v1.7.0: added credential-waterfall middleware for staged credential fallback, stream-prefetch helpers to reduce cold-start latency for streaming consumers, compatibility shims for Python/Go adapters. No breaking API changes; opt-in behavior behind flags.
description: Motivation: customers building low-latency streaming integrations reported occasional token churn and token-exchange hot paths that caused transient auth failures and increased first-byte latency for stream consumers. This PR adds a small, opt-in middleware called 'credential-waterfall' that tries credential sources in a staged order with progressive backoff and prefetch; it also introduces stream-prefetch helpers which warm KV cache and prime the runtime's small-batch path to reduce cold-start token latency. Summary of changes: (1) new src/auth/credential_waterfall.ts: an ergonomic middleware that composes multiple credential providers and exposes a lightweight lease/prefetch API; (2) new src/stream/prefetch.ts: helpers for warm-starting streaming requests including a prefetchWindow and jittered backoff policy; (3) compatibility shims: py-shim/credential_waterfall_adapter.py and go-adapter/cred_waterfall_adapter.go to make multi-lang examples show parity; (4) updated examples and tests and bumped package.json to v1.7.0. Compatibility: behavior is opt-in; existing SDK consumers are unaffected unless they enable the middleware via ClientConfig. Migration: documented usage in examples/ts/prefetch-quickstart.md; typical code change is single-line middleware registration. Testing & rollout: unit tests for middleware logic and integration e2e against local emulator added; canary release to 5% of package installs for one week recommended to measure error surface and median first-byte latency. Risks: overly-aggressive prefetch could increase token usage for idle clients; mitigated by default conservative prefetchWindow and telemetry-backed defaults. Related work: ENG-6217 (credential resiliency), SDK-203 (stream perf improvements).
